title: Story premise EDU105: The Alarm Reminder Outlasts the Beep
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Where did the instructions go after the alarm was installed? Takeaway/theme: Safety-device maintenance should follow the device’s instructions and applicable official guidance.
description: A resident wants a reliable reminder to check household alarms, but forgets the manufacturer’s maintenance instructions after installation. A reviewed animation links the specific device instructions to a recurring check record without demonstrating repairs.
